A '''fishing rod''' is a tool used for [[fishing]]. It works as in vanilla. Matcha Flavoured changes what it catches (see [[Fishing]]) and makes its enchantments {{MCW|Luck of the Sea}} and {{MCW|Lure}} cheaper to combine on an [[anvil]] (anvil cost 4 → 1).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/enchantment/luck_of_the_sea.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/enchantment/lure.json}}</ref>

=== Crafting ===

=== Fishing ===
Without luck, an enchanted fishing rod is 22.95% of [[fishing treasure]] (enchanted at level 30, with 0–25% of its durability left).

== Usage ==
Fishing is the main way to get [[fish]], which the [[Fisherman]] buys for [[Obol]]s.
